Jordan / Lauren — draft responses below and a quick note on evidence artifacts. I kept the language concise for procurement. Happy to expand any section.

1) EU AI Act applicability
- Position: For hosted API customers using Redwood pre-trained models, classification as 'general-purpose' vs 'high-risk' depends on customer use. Redwood offers configurable controls to help customers meet obligations. For services where the customer declares a high-risk use case (e.g., triage in regulated medical decision workflows), we recommend Private deployment + contractual commitments (conformity support).
- Controls mapped: technical documentation (model card + data schema), versioning & provenance, explainability summaries, incident logs, and continuous monitoring outputs.

2) NIST AI RMF mapping
- Identify: model inventory, data lineage, and documented purpose.
- Protect: role-based access, tenant isolation, KMS integration for keys.
- Detect: automated drift and anomaly detection + model performance dashboards.
- Respond: canary rollback policies, automated throttling to a safe baseline (smaller, vetted model), incident playbooks.
- Recover: snapshot-based rollbacks, audit trails for provenance and change management.

3) Continuous evaluation / regression approach
- Sampling cadence: weekly synthetic/real prompt sampling (customer-configurable), scalable to near-real-time for critical paths.
- Holdout & regression sets: maintain curated holdout prompts + customer-supplied sensitive prompts for targeted regression detection.
- Metrics: accuracy/ROUGE-like, hallucination rate estimation, semantic similarity drift, latency/throughput SLOs.
- Alerts & escalation: thresholded alerts to customer console, automated ticket creation, and optional on-call escalation to Redwood CS.
- Rollback: staged canary -> immediate rollback -> post-mortem and regression test update.

4) Evidence artifacts (what we attach)
- Model card (per model variant), evaluation harness outputs (sample CSV/aggregates), SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), and a template DPA addendum.

I'll attach a one-pager and the draft evaluation plan. Lauren — any legal caveats on the audit language?

Marcus
Product Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
